sections.thesis: Treasury yields turned lower as investors sought the safety of bonds once early enthusiasm over the Anthropic listing cooled.

sentences.text: Treasury yields turned lower as investors sought the safety of bonds once early enthusiasm over the Anthropic listing cooled.
The 10-year yield slipped to 5.051% from 5.065% and the two-year to 4.777% from 4.798%.

sections.thesis: The dollar rose to a new 52-week high, supported by expectations of further Fed tightening.

sections.thesis: Gold dropped more than 2.5% to its lowest since September 2025 as bets on further Fed rate hikes grew.
